title: Overview of PerpectiveArg2024: The First Shared Task on Perspective Argument Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the representation of different gender categories (male, female, nonbinary) in the top 20 retrieved arguments against a random sampling baseline and analyzing system performance deviation using nDCG scores.

Comparing the representation of different age bins (e.g., 18-34, 35-49, 50-64, 65+) in the top 20 retrieved arguments against a random sampling baseline and evaluating performance deviation using nDCG scores.

Evaluating the representation of various political orientations (e.g., left, right, conservative, liberal) and important political issues in the top-ranked arguments compared to a random baseline, alongside nDCG performance deviations.
Measuring the representation of argument authors from city versus countryside locations in the top 20 retrieved arguments against a random sampling baseline, and evaluating nDCG score deviations.
